notes.title: Duil Demo 0.8.2
notes.content:
We've published a new demo.
Even more content, even more dynamics, even more fights.

- New mobs
- More content
- Improved combat system
- Added internal teleporters
- More npc
- Improved map (M key)
- Mini-quests to get out of the location
  
[u][i]
If you have played the previous version, please delete your saves.
Main menu -> Settings -> Game -> Delete saves [/i][/u]
